description: Sets the appearance of the on-screen overlay that MIDI-CAT and SAIL show on parameter changes, and adds a magnifying loupe around the mouse pointer.
notes: the module has no controls on its panel; everything it does is set from its context menu and applies to the whole of Rack.
menu: Overlay settings — White text, Horizontal position of Center, Left or Right, Vertical position of Bottom or Top, and a Scale slider, all applying to every module that draws the overlay.
Magnifier — Hotkey learns the key that shows the loupe, Clear hotkey removes it, and Size (radius) and Zoom factor set how big it is and how far it magnifies.
